problem: Find the equation of the midline for a transformed sine function with a minimum value of $-7$ and a maximum value of $3.$

feedback.problem: Find the equation of the midline for a transformed cosine function with a minimum value of $3$ and a maximum value of $15.$
feedback.worked_solution:
A sinusoidal graph's midline (or vertical shift) is the horizontal line that divides it vertically in half. 

The equation of the midline is given by

$$
y=\frac{{y}_{\text{min}}+{y}_{\text{max}}}{2},
$$

where ${y}_{\text{min}}$ and ${y}_{\text{max}}$ are the minimum and maximum values of the function. The midline equals the average of the maximum and minimum values. 

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{y}_{\text{min}}+{y}_{\text{max}}}{2} & =\frac{3+15}{2} \\  & =\frac{18}{2} \\  & =9.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the midline is $y=9.$
